name: Heard
tagline: Give Claude Code and Codex a voice
description: Heard is a macOS voice layer for your agentic workflows. It connects to Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor and turns their output into intelligent summaries you can hear. Full commentary when your eyes are elsewhere, or silence until something errors or needs a decision. With agents run in parallel, Heard summarizes at the project level, so you hear where the work stands, not five terminals talking over each other. Pair your phone and it comes with you. Open source, free for personal use.

name: FluentDB
tagline: The AI database client for Mac
description: FluentDB is an AI-powered database client for macOS. It supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, with more coming soon. Built for speed, simplicity, and security, it works with Anthropic and OpenAI using your own API keys or Claude Code/Codex subscriptions, and with local models via Ollama. Your data never leaves your machine without your approval: models see your schema, not your data, and every AI-generated SQL query requires approval by default.

name: Second Brain for Mac and Windows
tagline: Your AI memory, everywhere you work
description: The Second Brain desktop app gets you running in five minutes. No terminal. No git. Just download, set a password, and sign into Cloudflare. Then the real magic starts. Persistent memory across every AI tool you use. Recall that just got a lot smarter. Surfaces the right memory, not just the newest one. A knowledge graph that builds itself. Your data in your own Cloudflare account, not ours. Mac and Windows. You asked for the app. You asked for better recall. We shipped both.

name: OpenComputer
tagline: The easiest way to deploy a managed agent.
description: The easiest way to deploy a managed agent. Say what your agent should do, paste one prompt into your coding agent, get a live agent URL.

name: Capsomnia
tagline: Caps Lock keeps your Mac awake, even with the lid closed
description: Capsomnia turns Caps Lock into a physical switch that keeps your MacBook awake. Keep Claude Code, Codex, other AI agents, SSH sessions, builds, downloads, and more running after you close the lid. If Caps Lock is already assigned, choose another shortcut. The Caps Lock light still shows whether Capsomnia is active. The app is free and open source, signed and notarized. No accounts or telemetry. We’ve already seen strong interest in Japan: 2.3M+ views and 6,000+ downloads.

name: Health in ChatGPT
tagline: Your personal health companion, powered by ChatGPT
description: Health in ChatGPT helps you better understand and navigate your health by bringing your health information into one conversation. Connect your health data, medical records, and wellness apps to get more personalized insights, track changes over time, prepare for appointments, understand results, and build healthier routines — all while staying in control of what you share.

name: Islet
tagline: iPhone's Dynamic Island, brought to your Mac's notch
description: Most notch utilities just draw a static shape over the cutout. Islet actually behaves like iPhone's Dynamic Island: native spring-physics expand/collapse, real-time HUDs for volume and brightness, a live music glance with full playback controls, one-tap audio output switching (no System Settings detour), plus calendar, weather, and a file tray you can drop into from anywhere. Built natively in Swift + AppKit, not Electron, fast and fullscreen-aware.

name: Speechius
tagline: The teleprompter that actually listens
description: Speechius listens to your voice and scrolls your script for you - speed up, slow down, go off-script, it keeps pace. No foot pedal, no fixed speed to chase. It works live in any tool - real webinars, Zoom, Meet, Teams, OBS - and stays hidden on screen-share. Fully on-device (private). One-time price, no subscription. macOS & Windows.

name: Wisprkey
tagline: Talk to any app on your Mac
description: Wisprkey is a free Mac app for voice typing. Set a global shortcut, 98% accuracy, 31 languages.

name: ShellMate
tagline: The SSH workspace you'll actually enjoy using
description: ShellMate is a modern SSH workspace built for developers, system administrators, and DevOps teams. Connect to unlimited servers with tabs, split terminals, SFTP, snippets, session sharing, and AI-powered assistance, all in one native desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Free forever for individual users without AI features, with affordable plans for teams that need collaboration and AI.

name: Seller by Facebook
tagline: The easiest way to sell on Facebook Marketplace
description: Seller is a dedicated app for Facebook Marketplace sellers to manage listings, connect with buyers, and grow their selling business. Create listings faster with AI, manage conversations in one inbox, track inventory, and understand your performance — all from one place.

name: Velane
tagline: Cloud for your AI Agent's tools and functions
description: Velane is the one platform for your AI Agent's tools and function. It is agent first, and fully controlled by your AI Agent (Claude, Codex, Cursor,..) It has: 1. Code Sandbox (with 0 cold start) 2. Version Control 3. Enviroments (dev, staging, prod) 4. 800+ Integrations (it replaces your iPaaS)

name: Browser FX:
tagline: Transform your web audio with real-time effects
description: Browser FX transforms your web audio experience with real-time professional audio effects. Capture any tab's audio and shape it with studio-style knobs in a sleek dark interface, complete with an audio-reactive cymatic visualizer, and even hands-on control from your MIDI controller.

name: ADE
tagline: All your coding agents, synced everywhere, free forever
description: Use any coding subscription you already pay for, in one synced app that runs on web, desktop, terminal, and mobile. All your chats stay synced between all ade surfaces. Run agents from your laptop, continue the conversation from your phone at dinner, then later finish it off from another computer by simply using the web client. All subs, all in one place. Fully free and open source!

name: Speech To Markdown
tagline: Harness local AI for notes
description: A free macOS and iOS app that turns your voice into structured markdown using local LLM. Global dictation anywhere with ⌘⌥], live markdown editor with on-the-fly fix with LLM. No cloud, no API keys — nothing leaves your Mac.

name: Banquish — Make the web your workspace
tagline: Clip living pieces of the web onto one canvas
description: Banquish is a Mac app that turns any website into a workspace. Pull the pieces you need onto one canvas, keep them live, and let an agent run the errands.

name: ClipStudios.AI
tagline: 15+ AI video models, one subscription — credits roll over
description: ClipStudios.AI brings 15+ AI video models — Kling 2.6/3.0, Veo 3.1, Runway, Seedance, Wan — into one credit-based subscription. Write a prompt, pick a model, get a video. Every video is C2PA-signed at creation (official C2PA Contributor Member). Edits made in ClipStudios preserve that signature; third-party tools may not yet — verifiable provenance on GDPR-native EU infrastructure. Also includes Script Studio, Voice Studio, Video Tools. Free tier available. Paid plans from €20/month.

name: Drifty - Context Aware AI Time Tracker
tagline: Bring Visibility to your Focus
description: Drifty is an AI time tracker for Mac that shows where your workday actually goes. Automatically track your work with no timers or manual tracking. AI understands the context behind your activity, separates focus from distraction, visualizes your daily workflow, and helps you understand your attention patterns. Need a little help staying focused? Drifty detects sustained distractions and gently nudges you back to work. Runs locally for privacy, with the option to use the cloud when you want.

name: Fund Momentum
tagline: Live GP intelligence for 970+ actively deploying VC funds
description: Most VC databases are static snapshots. Fund Momentum tracks 970+ actively deploying funds with live GP intelligence. - GP Signal Profiles — thesis tags, bullish/contrarian signals, Founder Dos & Don'ts - MCP Server — connect Claude or Cursor, query funds in plain language - FM15 — ranking scored on founder alignment, not AUM Built for founders tired of pitching funds that stopped deploying.

name: DockAMP Webstack Manager for Docker
tagline: Web interface to manage Apache/Nginx, PHP, DB containers
description: DockAMP is a Docker image with a responsive web interface to manage official Apache/Nginx, PHP, MySQL/MariaDB/PostgeSQL and proxy containers in Docker.
